children: said on Thursday its Primark clothing business, which it plans to spin off next year, will offer home delivery in the UK in the future.
Although Primark does offer a Click & Collect service in the UK, it has long resisted a move into home delivery, saying it did not make economic sense with its low price points.

"Primark's digital maturity, including the success of Click & Collect, and online market developments, mean there is now the opportunity for profitable growth through the home delivery channel," AB Foods said in a statement.
To enable this, Primark has acquired a highly-automated fulfilment facility in Sheffield, northern England, it added.
AB Foods said work on the demerger of Primark from its food businesses is progressing well and is expected to be completed in December 2027.
The group said Primark's like-for-like sales are expected to be down 3.0% in its fourth quarter to September 12, with the UK and Ireland up 0.4% but continental Europe down 4.3%.
It forecast group adjusted operating profit for its 2025-26 full year broadly in line with its previous expectations, with adjusted earnings per share ahead of its previous expectations.

title: AB Foods says Primark to offer home delivery in UK
